staging.title: Home staging
staging.hintSource: The instruction is written into the bar below: read it, adjust it, then generate.
staging.hintScratch: Without a source photo the scene is invented from scratch. Import a photo to furnish a real room.
staging.promptSource: {{room}} to furnish, {{style}} style: {{hint}}. Keep the architecture, windows, floors and perspective of the photo exactly as they are; add only furniture and decoration, with consistent shadows and the existing light. Photorealistic.
staging.promptScratch: {{room}}, {{style}} style: {{hint}}. Real-estate interior photography, natural light, eye-level perspective, photorealistic.
